title: Approval submission
description: The body of POST /approval/v1/requests (protocol 17.4). The PEP sends op, view and effect only here (protocol 17.9). It sends exactly one of approval_ref, lease_s and until. It sends no explanation, no allow_custom, no allow_ask_back and no hint (protocol 17.9a). A schema cannot check that effect is the hash of op, or that a pointer of view names a value of op. The PDP checks both.

evaluation_id.description: The evaluation_id of the false answer of the PDP (protocol 17.1). The PEP never reads it.

op.description: The values that decide what the operation does (protocol 17.3). The numbers are integers from -(2^53-1) to 2^53-1.

approval_ref.description: An opaque text that the agent gave to the service. The PEP never reads it (protocol 17.7).

lease_s.description: The seconds of the lease, in the mode of the lease (protocol 17.5). The PDP bounds the value and never changes it.

until.description: The time up to which the agent waits, as RFC 3339 text (protocol 17.5).

supersedes.description: The id of a request of the same subject that this request replaces.
